verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents two token tiers: a global API token valid across all teams, and a team-scoped Uptime API token limited to Uptime resources. Both are used as bearer tokens. That gives coarse team- and product-level scoping, but the evidence shows nothing finer-grained or designed for least-privilege agent access. Missing for 10: read-only or permission-level scopes, per-resource or per-action restrictions, agent-specific or short-lived credentials, a scoped token model documented for MCP access, and independent corroboration.
